about_the_game:
This demo offers the same gameplay content as the full version, with Steam Achievements disabled.
You can choose from 3 starting characters and recruit from 10 randomly available teammates. Additional characters require achievement points to unlock, which are not available in the demo.

Note: Progress made in the demo will not be saved or transferred to the full version.

We invite you to try the game and add it to your wishlist!
